## Sourcing

**Official source URL(s):**

- [ ] I opened the vendor's own page and read it myself
- [ ] `evidence_quote` is copied **verbatim** from `official_source`
- [ ] Every figure comes from the vendor's page — not a blog post, listicle or another list
- [ ] No affiliate, referral, `utm_*` or shortened links

## Eligibility honesty

- [ ] Any gate I set to `false` is **affirmatively stated** by the vendor. I left
      everything the page does not state as `unknown`.
- [ ] Funding limits point the right way — `funding_min_usd` for "must have raised
      at least", `funding_max_usd` for "must have raised under"
- [ ] `regions_basis` is `asserted` only if the vendor names the country, says
      worldwide, or names a region *and enumerates its countries*
- [ ] I did not flatten a tiered or multi-year offer into one headline number

> The absence of a stated restriction is not permission. Under-claiming is always
> preferable to sending a founder to an application they cannot win.

- [ ] I also confirmed or retired something existing, rather than only adding
